Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state the location where the collision happened.
A: It was on the freeway in Houston, Texas, in the middle lane near the interchange.
Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I was changing lanes to the right because my exit was coming up. I checked my mirror and my blind spot, and I
signaled.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you moved over?
A: Not clearly. I glanced at my mirror and didn't see anything beside me, but then I felt the contact along my
passenger side.
Q: Describe the contact.
A: It was a sideswipe. Their vheicle drifted into my lane as I was moving over, and our mirrors and doors scraped. My
car pulled slightly toward the shoulder, and I corrected it.
Q: Did you stop after the collision?
A: Yes, I pulled onto the shoulder right away and turned on my hazard lights.
Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes, I hurt my right knee. It struck the dashboard when I braced myself, and it's been swollen and painful since.
Q: Have you received medical treatment for the knee?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with a specialist.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I was driving carefully and I'm willing to provide any records you need.
Q: Thank you. This conculdes the statement.
A: Thank you.
</page>

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
